# Gripply

> Gripply is a business communications service for tradespeople and small businesses in the UK, from Gripply Limited, a company registered in England and Wales. It gives a business one number for calls, SMS and WhatsApp Business, brings Instagram and Messenger DMs into the same thread, records and transcribes calls, and turns what was agreed in each conversation into tracked to-dos, so nothing slips through. Early access is opening soon: join the waitlist at https://gripply.app/.

Gripply is a paid subscription that can be cancelled at any time, taking effect at the end of the current billing period. Pricing will be shared as early access rolls out.

Gripply is an app for iPhone and Android. To get a Gripply number, Gripply checks your ID and address and assigns a dedicated UK mobile number for calls and SMS. The check is usually done the same day but can take up to 72 hours. Gripply gives you a new business number rather than taking over your existing one. WhatsApp Business is switched on from the app, and Instagram and Messenger DMs arrive once a Facebook Page is connected.

The first time someone rings a Gripply number, they hear a short notice that calls and messages are recorded and processed; someone who messages first gets the notice in reply. Calls with contacts marked as personal are not recorded, apart from voicemail.

Features: missed-call text-back, captured commitments, one timeline per customer, calls recorded, transcribed and summarised, a smart diary, an AI daily brief, quotes customers accept from a link, invoices with payment by bank transfer or by card, Tap to Pay on Android (Android phones with NFC running Android 13 or later, once card payments are set up) and the Jobs tab.

Gripply Limited, company number 17169919, registered office 66 Paul Street, London EC2A 4NA, United Kingdom.
